meta.name: artifacts-builder
meta.description: Suite of tools for creating elaborate, multi-component claude.ai HTML artifacts using modern frontend web technologies (React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui). Use for complex artifacts requiring state management, routing, or shadcn/ui components - not for simple single-file HTML/JSX artifacts.

copy.tagline: 用现代前端技术构建复杂HTML交互组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Claude中创建带状态管理和路由的复杂HTML组件
copy.tagline_en: Build complex HTML interactive components with modern frontend tech
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create complex HTML components with state management and routing in Claude

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会使用 React、Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn/ui 创建多组件 HTML 工件。它会先初始化项目，开发完成后打包成单个 HTML 文件供你查看。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 创建需要状态管理、路由或 shadcn/ui 组件的复杂前端工件时触发。不适用于简单的单文件 HTML/JSX 工件。

say.text: 帮我做一个带登录表单的 React 页面，用 shadcn/ui 组件。
say.note: Claude 会初始化项目并生成代码。

say.text: 把刚才的 React 项目打包成单个 HTML 文件。
say.note: Claude 会运行打包脚本生成 bundle.html。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates multi-component HTML artifacts using React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui. It initializes a project, develops the artifact, and bundles it into a single HTML file for you to view.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create complex frontend artifacts requiring state management, routing, or shadcn/ui components. Not for simple single-file HTML/JSX artifacts.

say_en.text: Create a React page with a login form using shadcn/ui components.
say_en.note: Claude will initialize the project and generate code.

say_en.text: Bundle the React project into a single HTML file.
say_en.note: Claude will run the bundling script to produce bundle.html.
